name: 21st
description: 21st lets agents search a catalog of React UI components and add the chosen components to the project. Each user signs in to their own 21st account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find a pricing table component that fits this landing page.
Add a responsive navigation bar component to the header.
Show three date picker components and compare their props.

apps.name: 21st
apps.description: UI component search and install, over 21st's MCP server with browser sign-in.
